en.title: Anthropic Migrates Messages API from Python to Rust Using Autonomous Agents
en.summary: According to Anthropic Research: Anthropic reports it migrated its core **Messages API** from Python to Rust while keeping the live service running. By turning production traffic into a verifier and deploying autonomous agents to fix discrepancies, the new API achieves about **70% less CPU** usage per request and a faster response time.
en.full_summary:
According to Anthropic Research:

## Background and Challenge
Anthropic built its Messages API in Python in 2023, but as API traffic grew significantly and safety classifiers, prompt tokenization, and multi-step streaming added overhead, Python became a performance bottleneck. While incremental rewrites only yielded minor gains, a full rewrite was traditionally considered too risky due to incomplete test suites and the difficulty of defining correctness for a live, changing system.

## Verification and Autonomous Agents
To safely migrate the service without taking it offline, the team used the production system itself as an oracle. They set up a shadowing system that compared Python and Rust outputs on live traffic without reading private user data, utilizing **checkpoints and fingerprints** to isolate differences. Autonomous Claude agents operated within verification loops: a fast inner sandbox loop for iterative testing and a slower outer loop validating fixes against production traffic, while human engineers reviewed pull requests and guided policy.

## Results and Impact
The migration reduced CPU usage per request by about **70%** and cut the median time to first token by roughly 20%, all without freezing feature development or taking the service offline.

zh.title: Anthropic 使用自主智能体将消息 API 从 Python 迁移至 Rust
zh.summary: 据Anthropic Research发布的信息：Anthropic 宣布在保持服务运行的同时，成功将其核心**消息 API** 从 Python 迁移至 Rust。通过将生产流量转化为验证器并部署自主智能体来修复差异，新 API 每个请求的 **CPU 消耗**减少了约 70%，并加快了响应速度。
zh.full_summary:
据Anthropic Research发布的信息：

## 背景与挑战
Anthropic 在 2023 年用 Python 构建了消息 API，但随着 API 流量激增，安全分类器、提示词分词和多步流式传输带来了巨大开销，Python 逐渐成为性能瓶颈。虽然增量重写收效甚微，但由于测试集不完整以及难以定义动态系统的正确性，全面重写在过去被认为风险极高。

## 验证与自主智能体
为了在不中断服务的情况下安全迁移，团队将生产系统本身作为验证预言机。他们建立了一个影子测试系统，在不读取用户隐私数据的情况下比对 Python 和 Rust 在真实流量下的输出，并利用**检查点和指纹**来精准定位差异。自主的 Claude 智能体在验证循环中运行：快速的内部沙盒循环用于迭代测试，较慢的外部循环针对生产流量验证修复结果，而人类工程师则负责审查代码合并请求并引导修正规则。

## 成果与影响
这次迁移使每个请求的 **CPU 消耗**降低了约 70%，并将首字响应的中位时间缩短了约 20%，整个过程既没有冻结功能开发，也没有让服务下线。

en.title: Anthropic researchers shrink Riemann hypothesis proof by 99.5 percent using AI
en.summary: Anthropic researcher Luke Sernau and colleagues, working with Claude, have reduced a massive 17.4-million-line formal proof of the Riemann hypothesis down to about 76,000 lines. The original proof, created by mathematician Levent Alpöge and Claude, was so massive that it took over 21 hours to compile on high-end AWS hardware. In contrast, the newly streamlined version builds in just one to two hours on a standard 12-core, 24GB machine and has passed multiple independent verifications.
en.full_summary:
## Background
Earlier, mathematician Levent Alpöge collaborated with Anthropic's Claude to release a 17.4-million-line formal proof of the Riemann hypothesis and generalized Riemann hypothesis in Lean. While it was a major milestone, the massive text contained over 175,000 files with almost no comments, making it nearly impossible for human mathematicians to read and verify directly.

## Refactoring Details
Anthropic researcher Luke Sernau and his colleagues stepped in to completely rewrite and restructure the proof with Claude. They released two versions: a readable version with around 300,000 lines of code accompanied by documentation, and a compact version trimmed down to roughly **7,600 lines** of pure code across 792 files. Sernau explained that the reduction was achieved by unrolling definitions to find global simplifications across module boundaries, rewriting certain sub-arguments, and then repackaging the code.

## Impact
This dramatic shrinkage brings human-readable mathematical understanding much closer, translating the proof to a scale roughly equivalent to a 1,300-page paper. The entire streamlined code relies on standard Lean axioms and has passed independent checks by multiple verification tools. Additionally, the project has been **open-sourced under the Apache 2.0 license**, allowing the broader mathematical and AI community to freely use and study it.

zh.title: Anthropic研究员用AI将黎曼猜想证明代码暴砍99.5%
zh.summary: Anthropic研究员Luke Sernau等人与Claude合作，将此前轰动全网的**1740万行**黎曼猜想形式化证明大幅瘦身，精简至约**7.6万行**代码。原版证明体量庞大，在AWS高配机器上需要21小时才能编译完；而重构后的新版本只需一台普通机器便可在1到2小时内构建完毕，并且已经通过了多方独立检查器的交叉验证。
zh.full_summary:
## 背景回顾
此前，数学家Levent Alpöge与Anthropic的AI模型Claude合作，发布了长达1740万行的黎曼猜想Lean语言形式化证明。虽然证明通过了机器验证，但它包含超过17.5万个文件且几乎没有注释，宛如天书，让社区直呼难以阅读和维护。

## 重构细节
Anthropic研究员Luke Sernau与同事和Claude合作，对原版证明进行了彻底重构。他们一口气放出了两个版本：一个是带详细文档、约30万行的可读版；另一个是专为极简设计的紧凑版，仅剩约**7.6万行**纯代码。Sernau透露，其核心秘诀在于“先拍扁、跨界消消乐、再封装”，即将嵌套的定义全部展开以消除模块边界的阻碍，同时在局部数学路径上进行了重写。

## 行业影响
代码量暴砍99.5%意味着，这份证明对应的论文体量从25万页缩减到了不到1300页，让人类数学家读懂它成为了可能。该项目不仅通过了Lean官方内核和多个独立检查器的交叉验证，还**在Apache 2.0许可下完全开源**，将验证与探索的主动权重新交回给全球数学社区。

en.title: US clears SpaceX to launch up to one million orbital data center satellites
en.summary: The US FCC has authorized SpaceX to launch up to **one million satellites** to build data centers in space, with approval valid until 2040. Tech giants and startups are racing to move AI computing into orbit to **tap into continuous solar power**.
en.full_summary:
According to Le Monde and AFP, the US Federal Communications Commission authorized SpaceX on Wednesday, November 25, to launch up to one million satellites for orbital data centers under an approval valid until 2040. Projects in this sector have grown significantly, involving companies like Google with its Suncatcher project and Blue Origin with Project Sunrise, alongside startups such as Starcloud. SpaceX plans to use its own rockets, with Elon Musk promising an initial launch in the fourth quarter of 2027 and increased deployment in 2028, backed by a deal with Nvidia for Vera Rubin processors designed for space.

While space-based data centers benefit from sun-synchronous orbits that capture solar energy continuously and with eight times the efficiency of ground systems, significant technical hurdles remain. These challenges include protecting processors from high radiation, handling extreme temperatures, and avoiding space debris and micrometeorites, as reported by Le Monde.

zh.title: 美国批准SpaceX发射多达一百万颗轨道数据中心卫星
zh.summary: 美国联邦通信委员会已授权SpaceX发射多达**一百万颗卫星**，用于在太空中构建数据中心，该许可有效期至2040年。科技巨头和初创企业正竞相将AI计算转移至轨道，以**利用持续的太阳能**。
zh.full_summary:
据《世界报》与法新社报道，美国联邦通信委员会于11月25日星期三授权SpaceX发射多达一百万颗卫星用于轨道数据中心建设，该批准有效期至2040年。此类太空数据中心项目近期激增，参与者包括谷歌的Suncatcher项目、蓝色起源的Project Sunrise以及初创企业Starcloud。SpaceX计划利用自有火箭，埃隆·马斯克承诺在2027年第四季度进行首次发射并在2028年加紧部署，同时该公司已与英伟达达成协议，由其供应专为太空运行设计的Vera Rubin处理器。

尽管位于太阳同步轨道的数据中心能够持续捕获太阳能，其效率可达地面同类设施的八倍，但据《世界报》报道，仍有诸多技术难题尚未完全解决。这些挑战包括确保处理器能够抵御太空高辐射、应对极端温度，以及避免太空垃圾和微陨石带来的损害。

en.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Apologizes at All-Hands Meeting; Apple's iPhone Duo Hits Record High Component Costs
en.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang publicly apologized at his first all-hands meeting since returning to the role, admitting to personal mistakes and vowing to change his management style. Meanwhile, teardown data reveals that Apple's upcoming foldable iPhone Duo features **record-high component costs**, driven by expensive hinges and memory chips. Additionally, Anthropic's stock has **dipped below its IPO price** just days after listing, and Sand.ai launched its **top-ranking MAGI-2** audio-video generation model.
en.full_summary: During his first all-hands meeting following his reinstatement, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang addressed employees directly, acknowledging that he violated company policy and harmed relationships. He announced that he is undergoing psychological therapy and will accept 360-degree performance reviews to shift away from his historically aggressive management style. In hardware news, a teardown of Apple's iPhone Duo revealed 2,644 components across 145 types. Its **cost ratio reached 64%** of its retail price, making it the most expensive iPhone to produce historically, largely due to a complex dual-hinge design and surging DRAM prices. In the AI sector, Anthropic's stock closed below its IPO price for the first time, falling about 26.5% from its opening peak, which analysts say could complicate OpenAI's future public listing plans. Concurrently, Sand.ai released MAGI-2, a 480-billion parameter audio-video generation model that **topped the Artificial Analysis leaderboard** while undercutting competitors on price.

zh.title: 黄仁勋复职后首次向英伟达员工道歉，苹果折叠屏手机零部件成本创新高
zh.summary: 英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋在复职后首次全员大会上公开道歉，承认个人错误并表示将改进管理方式。与此同时，拆解报告显示苹果首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 的**零部件成本创新高**，主要受昂贵的铰链和存储芯片拖动。此外，Anthropic 上市仅几天便**跌破发行价**，而 Sand.ai 则发布了**登顶全球第一**的 MAGI-2 音视频生成模型。
zh.full_summary: 在复职后的首次全员大会上，英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋向员工坦诚了自己的个人错误，承认违反了公司行为准则并伤害了相关人员。他表示将接受心理治疗，并通过 360 度绩效评估来调整以往过于强势的管理风格。在硬件动态方面，市场研究机构对苹果首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 进行了拆解，发现其包含 2644 个零部件，**成本率高达 64%**，创下历代 iPhone 新高，高昂的铰链设计和存储器价格是主要推手。在人工智能领域，Anthropic 股价在上市数日后首次跌破发行价，较开盘高点明显回落，分析认为这可能对 OpenAI 未来的上市计划带来不确定性。此外，Sand.ai 正式发布了 480 亿参数的音视频生成模型 MAGI-2，在相关榜单上**登顶全球第一**，并计划尽快开源模型权重。

en.title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
en.summary: According to OpenAI News: OpenAI reports that its GPT-6 family of models can design new protein shapes and chemical sequences using reasoning and code, without relying on specialized biology tools. In laboratory tests with partner Onava, engineered proteins showed evidence of binding across multiple targets, though specialized models were still used to help filter and select candidates.
en.full_summary:
According to OpenAI News:

OpenAI details how its GPT-6 family of models exhibits intrinsic protein-design capabilities, leveraging mathematical, physical, chemical, and biological knowledge through general-purpose reasoning and coding tools. According to the research, the models can generate three-dimensional structures for small proteins known as minibinders, redesign amino acid sequences for existing structures, and modify binding loops on antibodies to preserve target attachment.

In laboratory validations conducted with partner Onava, proteins derived from GPT-6.2 designs showed positive binding across five target proteins. Furthermore, the models demonstrated success in computational tasks such as motif scaffolding and small-molecule docking, often matching or outperforming specialized biology models like RFdiffusion and DiffDock-L.

Despite these advances, OpenAI notes several limitations. The workflow still relies on specialized tools like Boltz-2 and ESMFold2 to filter and validate candidates, and predicting complete protein structures from scratch remains a significant weakness compared to dedicated structural models. The research highlights a step toward programmable molecular design via natural language while emphasizing ongoing biosecurity evaluations.

zh.title: OpenAI新一代 GPT-6 模型展现原生蛋白质设计能力
zh.summary: 据OpenAI News发布的信息：OpenAI 宣布，其 GPT-6 系列模型能够仅凭推理和代码直接设计全新的蛋白质形状和化学序列，而无需依赖专门的生物学模型。在与合作伙伴 Onava 进行的实验室测试中，这些人工智能设计的蛋白质在多个靶点上表现出了结合能力，不过候选蛋白质的筛选和过滤仍需借助专业模型来协助完成。
zh.full_summary:
据OpenAI News发布的信息：

OpenAI 详细介绍了其 GPT-6 系列模型如何通过通用推理和编程工具，利用数学、物理、化学和生物学知识展现出原生的蛋白质设计能力。研究显示，该模型不仅能为被称为微型结合剂的小型蛋白质生成三维结构，还能为现有结构重新设计氨基酸序列，并修改抗体上的结合环以保持对靶标的抓握。

在与合作伙伴 Onava 共同进行的实验室验证中，基于 GPT-6.2 设计方案制造出的蛋白质在五个靶点上均显示出了结合迹象。此外，这些模型在基序支架搭建和小分子对接等计算任务中也表现优异，其性能在多项测试中匹配甚至超过了 RFdiffusion 和 DiffDock-L 等专业生物学模型。

尽管取得了这些进展，OpenAI 也指出了现阶段的局限性。整个工作流目前仍需依赖 Boltz-2 和 ESMFold2 等专业结构预测工具来过滤和筛选候选者，且与专用结构模型相比，从头预测完整蛋白质结构依然是该模型的一大弱点。这项研究标志着迈向通过自然语言进行可编程分子设计的一步，同时也强调了持续进行生物安全评估的重要性。

en.title: Verifiable Social Reasoning for LLM Assistants
en.summary: According to Google Research: Google researchers introduce an **evaluation framework** using multi-agent simulations to test how well AI assistants handle social reasoning through subjective user narratives. Testing 12 LLMs reveals that relying on **user-mediated reality** complicates reasoning, as models are easily swayed by user biases and framing.
en.full_summary:
According to Google Research:

## The User-Mediated Reality Challenge
Unlike objective tasks like math or coding, when AI assistants give personal advice, they don't observe social interactions firsthand. Instead, they rely solely on the **subjective lens of the user**, creating an information asymmetry where omitted context or personal bias can lead the model to validate one-sided assumptions rather than offer objective assessments.

## Multi-Agent Simulation Approach
To solve the lack of verifiable ground truth in everyday social interactions, the researchers developed a five-step evaluation framework using the open-source Concordia library. The framework starts with a controllable entity possessing a **hidden motive**, has simulated characters interact naturally, and then has the user agent consult the evaluated assistant. This setup separates simulation from debrief, generating over 20,000 examples for testing.

## Key Findings and Open Sourcing
Testing 12 LLMs uncovered several issues: an **assistant-observer gap** where models perform worse through subjective user lenses, high sensitivity to user framing, and the failure of multi-turn conversations to always improve accuracy due to anchoring effects. Google has **open-sourced the framework** and dataset to encourage further research.

zh.title: 给AI助手测测情商：如何用模拟现实评估大模型的社交推理能力
zh.summary: 据Google Research发布的信息：谷歌研究人员推出了一套基于**多智能体模拟**的评估框架，用来测试AI助手通过主观用户叙事进行社交推理的能力。对12个大模型的测试表明，依赖**用户中介现实**会使社交推理变得复杂，因为模型很容易被用户的偏见和主观框架所左右。
zh.full_summary:
据Google Research发布的信息：

## 用户中介现实的挑战
与数学或编程等客观任务不同，当AI助手给出个人建议时，它们无法亲眼观察社交互动，而是完全依赖**用户的客观主观视角**。这造成了一种信息不对称，遗漏的背景或个人偏见可能会引导模型去附和片面的假设，而不是提供客观的评估。

## 多智能体模拟方法
为了解决日常社交互动中缺乏可验证客观真相的问题，研究人员利用开源的Concordia库开发了一个五步评估框架。该框架从一个具有**隐藏动机**的可控实体开始，让模拟角色自然互动，然后由用户代理向被评估的助手咨询。这种设置将模拟与汇报分离，生成了超过2万个测试样本。

## 关键发现与开源共享
对12个大模型的测试揭示了几个问题：存在**助手与观察者的差距**，即模型通过主观用户视角时的表现更差；对用户设定的框架高度敏感；并且由于锚定效应，多轮对话并不总能提高准确性。谷歌已将该**框架与数据集开源**，以鼓励进一步的研究。

en.title: Anthropic Mathematician Clarifies That 250,000-Page Riemann Hypothesis Proof Was a Joke
en.summary: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge clarified on social media that his claim of a **250,000-page** proof for the Riemann Hypothesis was actually a joke, though the project did generate **17.37 million lines** of Lean formal code. Alpöge admitted that the code contains a lot of redundant and messy parts, sparking discussions on how AI-generated proofs outpace human comprehension.
en.full_summary:
Recently, Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge clarified several controversies surrounding the formal proof of the Riemann Hypothesis conducted in collaboration with Claude. Alpöge admitted that his earlier claim about the proof translating to over 250,000 pages was meant as a joke, as he thought his verbose description of real numbers would make the humor obvious. However, the accompanying **17.37 million lines** of Lean formal code are very real. While the Lean and Mathlib community expressed confidence in the verification, Alpöge acknowledged that the code contains significant **redundancy and low-quality parts** that need sorting.

Beyond the code controversy, Alpöge emphasized that the ultimate goal is to build more natural and unified mathematical frameworks rather than just churning out complex proofs. He noted that as AI accelerates mathematical derivations, a pressing challenge emerges: AI can generate proofs much faster than humans can fully comprehend them, meaning mathematicians now face the heavy task of turning these machine-checked answers into intuitive human knowledge.

zh.title: Claude 黎曼猜想证明主导者回应：25 万页其实是个玩笑
zh.summary: Anthropic 数学家 Levent Alpöge 在社交平台澄清，此前引发热议的 **25 万页**黎曼猜想证明其实只是个玩笑，但项目确实生成了 **1737 万行**的 Lean 形式化代码。Alpöge 坦言代码中存在不少冗余，这也引发了外界对 AI 时代人类理解速度跟不上生成速度的讨论。
zh.full_summary:
日前，Anthropic 数学家 Levent Alpöge 发文回应了此前与 Claude 合作证明黎曼猜想引发的种种争议。Alpöge 澄清说，所谓翻译成人类可读文字超过 **25 万页**的说法其实是一个玩笑，他本以为其中的幽默成分很明显，没想到被外界当真。不过，项目所产出的 **1737 万行** Lean 形式化证明代码则是真实存在的。尽管 Lean 社区对代码正确性表示有信心，但 Alpöge 坦言代码中确实包含大量**冗余和垃圾**，未来需要花大量时间进行整理和简化。

除了代码争议，Alpöge 还指出，证明黎曼猜想的更深层意义在于构建更加自然和统一的数学理论框架。随着 AI 参与数学推导的速度越来越快，甚至超越了人类消化细节的速度，如何将计算机生成的大规模证明提炼为人类能够理解和吸收的知识，成了数学界接下来不得不面对的新挑战。

en.title: Huawei Veterans Turn Chip Startup into Multi-Billion Unicorn
en.summary: Founded by former Huawei executives, Shanghai-based baseband chip maker Starsemi has secured CSRC filing for a Hong Kong IPO after raising nearly 1.5 billion yuan across three rounds in 2026. Despite facing a severe funding crunch and a valuation cut two years ago, the company survived by **early betting on low-earth orbit satellite communications**. This strategic pivot and growing state backing have propelled it into a **multibillion-dollar valuation tier**, highlighting the booming commercial aerospace supply chain.
en.full_summary:
Starsemi was established in Shanghai in October 2020 by industry veterans including CEO Xia Lusheng and CTO Lin Qing, both with extensive backgrounds at Huawei. Backed by early investors like Hillhouse Capital, the startup initially focused on 5G baseband chips. However, the 2023 venture capital winter left the company stranded without commercial revenue, forcing management to accept a valuation cut from nearly 5 billion yuan to 3 billion yuan. 

To survive, Starsemi pivoted heavily toward **low-earth orbit satellite internet and 5G NTN technology**, a move that preceded similar strategic shifts by major players like SpaceX. In 2025, its CS7620 chip successfully powered high-definition satellite calls on smartphones, helping the company secure product certifications from leading phone and auto makers. 

In 2026, driven by national policy support for 6G and commercial aerospace, Starsemi completed three financing rounds totaling nearly 1.5 billion yuan, with **local government funds aggressively backing the company**. Now holding a valuation over 10 billion yuan, the firm is advancing its Hong Kong IPO, though it remains in a **high-research-investment and pre-profit stage** amid mounting competition from both domestic and international rivals.

zh.title: 华为老兵把濒死芯片公司带成百亿独角兽
zh.summary: 由前华为员工创立的上海芯片企业星思半导体近日获得赴港上市备案，今年已连续完成三轮近15亿元融资，估值突破百亿元。两年前该公司曾因资金链紧张面临估值打折和发不出工资的困境，但通过**提前押注卫星通信**绝处逢生。随着**地方国资密集入局**与商业航天风口到来，这家差点熬不过寒冬的创业公司成功逆袭，站上了资本市场的新起点。
zh.full_summary:
星思半导体由曾任职于华为的夏庐生和林庆等人于2020年在上海创立，早期曾获得高瓴创投等机构的青睐并顺利完成首款芯片流片。但在2023年的一级市场寒冬中，由于缺乏规模化订单，公司陷入严重资金危机，创始人甚至需要自筹资金发工资。为了摆脱困境，星思选择主动下调估值至30亿元，并将研发重点从传统的地面5G转向了**低轨卫星互联网与手机直连卫星技术**。

这一前瞻性布局让星思赶上了商业航天的时代风口。2025年，其芯片成功支持了手机卫星视频通话，目前已获得多家头部手机和车企的认证。2026年以来，随着国家对商业航天和6G的支持力度加大，星思迎来了**地方国资的疯狂抢投**，年内连融三轮拿下近15亿元，投后估值突破百亿。

目前，星思已正式向证监会提交港股上市备案。尽管技术研发和资本认可度极高，但公司目前仍然处于**高研发投入且尚未盈利**的阶段，未来还将面临国内外同行的激烈竞争与港交所的严格审核。
